package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for repository_method_returns_partially_built_scopes_for_caller_chaining: Repositories that expose scope-building fragments instead of complete query APIs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type Post struct {
	ID       uint   `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Title    string `gorm:"size:256"`
	Status   string `gorm:"size:32"`
	AuthorID uint   `gorm:"index"`
	Deleted  bool   `gorm:"default:false"`
}

type PostRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func NewPostRepo(db *gorm.DB) *PostRepo {
	return &PostRepo{db: db}
}

func (r *PostRepo) PublishedScope() *gorm.DB {
	return r.db.Where("status = ?", "published").Where("deleted = ?", false)
}

func (r *PostRepo) ByAuthorScope(authorID uint) *gorm.DB {
	return r.PublishedScope().Where("author_id = ?", authorID)
}

func (r *PostRepo) RecentScope(limit int) *gorm.DB {
	return r.PublishedScope().Order("id DESC").Limit(limit)
}

var _ = gorm.ErrRecordNotFound
